sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our long cooperation with your family foundry and the care your team puts into every PH-100 housing.

We have looked closely at the labour costs you raised. Manufacturing labour costs changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3).

We would like to give you more security through a longer term. Any of these would work for us:
- Option A: EUR 49.73 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 49.54 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01
- Option C: EUR 49.34 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
The index change figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you.
The contract term is reflected in the price.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.60 per unit.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the step you made on price and on the payment terms. We value our cooperation with your family firm and want it to stay healthy for both sides. We are sorry our index figures caused doubt, and we appreciate that you checked our delivery data so carefully.

We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

We would like to move a step toward you as well and keep the package you answered:

- Option A: EUR 50.56 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027
- Option B: EUR 50.24 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Our terms: a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your revised offer and have reviewed your should-cost estimate, which allows us to make a further step towards you.
We can offer €51.30 per unit for the package starting 1 April 2027.
Regarding your technical question, our engineers can review the tolerances, but the current design requires our standard process to guarantee the quality you rely on.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
